configuration.policy: consistent_hash on both P and D, or all Hybrid endpoints
configuration.stable_session_key: same SHA-256 of first user message as vLLM comparison; 8 unique conversations

workload.warmup: all 16 P/D pairs or all 8 Hybrid endpoints, then two full workload rounds

cache_definition: sum P engine-output cached_tokens (or Hybrid cached_tokens) / sum request prompt_tokens; includes local and Store reuse; only 40 business requests per round
